Meet Mr. Manoj Kumar Yadav

Run by someone who lives in this bazaar too

Anjali RCM Wonder World at Chatra More, Chauparan is run by Mr. Manoj Kumar Yadav — a para teacher by profession who has also been working with RCM for almost 15 years. The shop brings RCM's grocery, wellness, personal-care and household range within easy reach of your home.

"Transforming lives with the power of values — that's not just on our signboard, it's how we choose every product we put on the shelf."

Every visit here is meant to feel familiar: known faces, fair prices and someone who'll tell you honestly if a product suits your need or not.

Questions? We have answers

What are your shop timings?

We are open every day from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM at Chatra More, Pillar No. 14, Chauparan.

Are these genuine RCM products?

Yes. Our range is RCM's own products, and prices shown are RCM's listed MRP.

Do you deliver to my home?

You can choose Store pickup or Home delivery at checkout. Message us on WhatsApp to confirm delivery for your area.

How can I pay?

Online payment is being set up. For now you can send your order on WhatsApp and pay at the store or on delivery.

A product is not listed. What should I do?

Our list is growing. Message us on WhatsApp and we will tell you if it is available.
